<reason>A won by keeping the motion as written: the fill calendar is the use, and Egypt’s objections cannot freeze an unfinished rulebook. B’s timing-versus-volume, famine-versus-postponement, and self-audit turns were the sharper theory, but three clipped speeches and a “protocol not veto” alternative never escaped A’s practical point that stalled talks plus Aswan’s existing buffer still leave Ethiopia waiting in the dark.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s R1 turn of B’s “build, own, and light every home” concession—“a dam you cannot commission on your own calendar is concrete, not electricity”—locked fill-as-use and forced B onto a procedure-without-freeze dilemma it never fully escaped.</best_rebuttal>
